Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game! The action keeps on coming from the World Cup as on the 14th of this month, we will see Australia take on Bangladesh at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT) Do join us for the build up. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Sune Luus first thanks the crowd for the support. Adds they wanted to bat with intent and build some stand. Reckons the spinners did a brilliant job but overall a good bowling performance. On Chloe Tryon, she says she showed her class and made a difference.

Sophie Devine says she is not sure what is happening with the bat, feels it is embarrassing and not good enough at this level. Adds they believed they will chase it down but they are disappointed now. Reckons they have to let go of the emotions and take some time away.

Chloe Tryon is the Player of the Match. She says they knew it was important to win this match and they just did the basics right. Adds they needed this win badly. Reckons she felt 15-20 runs short. Tells she is loving the role with the ball and is happy to get some wickets.
Presentation time...

New Zealand Women just didn't arrive with the bat. After losing Brits in the first over, they never got themselves up. The Kiwis kept on losing wickets. Hopes were tangled with Sophie Devine in the middle but she was struggling badly and once she got out it was just a procession. Nothing to blame on the bowling side but New Zealand Women have to do much better than this with the bat.

A no-contest really! New Zealand were outsmarted by the hosts who kick off the tournament finally. South Africa Women really turned up when it mattered the most. First, after choosing to bat, kept on losing wickets but the stand between Chloe Tryon and Nadine de Klerk turned out to be a match winning one as both scored some crucial runs. Above 130 is always going to be a tough one but with some brilliant bowling, South Africa builded the pressure with some amazing fielding as well.
OUT! BOWLED! Length ball, slower and on off. Jonas fails to get her bat on it and the ball sneaks through and hit the stumps. South Africa Women win by 65 runs.
Wide! A bouncer on middle. Jonas lets it go. Wided for height.
Close! On a length and on off, Carson defends it very late.
On off, pushed to long off for a single.
Length ball, outside off, knocked to overs.
This is full and outside off, Jonas looks to push but misses.
On off, kept out.
OUT! BOWLED! Ismail gets her first! On a length and from wide of the crease, this is angled on middle and leg. Kerr looks to flick but misses and the ball rattles the stumps.
Full and on off, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Carson turns it to mid-wicket for one.
A  single as Kerr plays it to long on.
Full and on off, drilled to long on for one.
Flatter and outside off, Carson looks to punch but misses.
On middle, Kerr hits it to long on for one.
Outside off, worked to mid-wicket for one more.
Fuller and on middle, nudged to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A single as this is hit to long on.
Outside off, guided to point.
FOUR! Much needed! Too full and outside off, Kerr drives and beats the cover fielder for four.
Too full and outside off, Kerr fails to drive it away.
Tad short on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On off, played to cover for a single.
On middle, blocked out.

OUT! LBW! Tahuhu is given out LBW but she take it upstairs. Again this looks plumb to the naked eye. No bat. THREE REDS and New Zealand Women lose their eight! Nonkululeko Mlaba gets her third. Flatter and on off, angles in and holds its line. Tahuhu plays inside the line and get hit on the flap of the pads. That was clearly out.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
On off, pushed to covers for a single.
Very full on middle, pushed to mid off.
Outside off, Kerr looks to cut but misses.

OUT! LBW! That looks plumb. Devine still wants to check her luck as she take it upstairs. Looks very straight. THREE REDS. Yes, South Africa Women are celebrating. The struggle ends for Devine! Tossed up on middle. Devine prods to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. This looks New Zealand game now.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket. A collision between two players as they both go for the ball but no harm done. Two runs,
A yorker, angling on the pads. Devine misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. It was going down.

OUT! RUN OUT! Jansen goes and New Zealand Women slip further! Length ball, outside off, Jensen works it to mid off. It was her call and she runs for a single but Ayabonga Khaka comes with a beamer of a throw and scores at the bowler's end finding Jensen well short.
On middle, eased to long on for a single.
Very full and outside off, Jensen look to drive as she skips down but misses. The keeper fails to collect cleanly and there goes a chance as well.
A quick single as Devine cuts this through point.
Outside off, Devine yet again fails to hit past point.
A full toss on middle but Jensen just pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Outside off, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off, length and it is pushed to point for a single.
Another dot! Devine cannot find any gaps! On off, Devine plays it back to the bowler.
Outside off, Devine plays it late but finds short third man.
Full and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Too full and on off, kept out.
Slower one, outside off, Jensen misses her drive.
FOUR! Important runs! Much needed! This will make Devine happy! Length ball, outside off, Devine slaps it late past point for four.
Length and on off, Jensen drops it to cover for one.
Short again, Devine slaps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short in length and around off, pulled to mid-wicket for one.
A slower length ball, outside off. Jensen looks to cut but misses.
On middle, defended out.
On the pads, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, Jensen looks to drive but misses.
Outside off, slapped to point for a quick single.
On middle, nudged to square leg for a single.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! New Zealand Women lose half of their side! Short and outside off, Green mistimes her reverse hit and gets a top edge. It deflects and hits her body as well before spooning it back to the keeper.
Commentary.Howout: c Sinalo Jafta b Chloe Tryon

A single as this is hit to mid-wicket.

Fuller and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up, outside off, Green steps across and nudges it to mid-wicket for two.

Length ball, closer to off. Devine looks to cut but misses. She is struggling badly.

Length ball, outside off, Green swings and misses.

Full and on off, eased to long on for a single.

Outside off, cut to point. A good throw at the bowler's end and it would have been curtains for Devine.

Bang a bouncer, outside off. Green lets it go.

Drags it back now, outside off, Devine looks to cut but misses.

On a length and outside off, Kerr looks to slash at it but misses. An appeal but nothing from the umpire. Hang on, South Africa Women look interested and have taken it upstairs. A BIG SPIKE on the UltraEdge. What a review. Excellent from the keeper, she pushed the skipper for it. New Zealand Women in more trouble.
Commentary.Howout: c Sinalo Jafta b Ayabonga Khaka

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, pushed to mid on.
Wide this time as Kerr misses her flick down the leg side.
Length ball, tailing down leg. Kerr misses her flick. Might have brushed the pads as not given as a wide.
This one tails back in. Kerr blocks.
FOUR! Threads it through! Outside off, Kerr stays back and drills it through point for four.
Length and on middle, blocked out.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! South Africa Women are up for the charge! Plimmer comes down the track and Kapp serves it short and way outside edge. Plimmer had to reach for it but gets a faint edge to the keeper who makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Sinalo Jafta b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: This is full and on off. Plimmer takes the charge and hits but finds cover.
On the hips, this is pulled behind square leg for one.
On middle, punched to mid on.
FOUR! That will release some pressure! Full and outside off, Kerr drives it crisply through covers.
Outside off, Plimmer works it to point. Top class from Mlaba.
A single! Tossed up on off, dropped to cover for a quick single.
Flighted outside off, Kerr drives it to point.
Slower and outside off, Kerr slaps it to point.
Outside off, Kerr keeps it out.

OUT! GONE! Nonkululeko Mlaba gets the other openers and she is on a roll! An arm ball, flatter and angles around off, fractionally stays low. Bates opens her body to pull but misses and it hits the stumps. Big, big wicket this.
Full and outside off, driven straight to point.
On a length and on middle. Plimmer flicks in the gap to square leg for two.
This is very full and close to the off pole. Plimmer looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On off, kept out.
FOUR! First off the chase! Short in length and outside off, Plimmer pulls it over mid on for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, Plimmer punches it to cover.
Slower, full, outside off, Bates punches it to point.
New Zealand Women are underway! On middle, Plimmer sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Short and outside off, Plimmer pulls it to mid on.
Flat and outside off, punched to cover.

OUT! STUMPED! Perfect start by the hosts! They could not have asked for a better one! Tossed up, outside off, spins away. Bezuidenhout is loose as she skips down, and tries to poke but misses. Was late to react as well. The keeper removes the bails and the replay shows she had her foot in the air.
Commentary.Howout: st Sinalo Jafta b Nonkululeko Mlaba

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and outside off, Bezuidenhout waits and guides it to short third man.
